source_claim: Square Enix/Kingdom Hearts official game manuals identify Roxas and Olette in the KINGDOM HEARTS II character section, and identify Naminé in the Chain of Memories story overview; the 358/2 Days overview also identifies Roxas as joining Organization XIII and befriending Axel and Xion.
notes: Checked the first-party KH 2.5 manual https://www.kingdomhearts.com/kh25manual/kingdom_hearts_25_manual_us.pdf and first-party KH 1.5 manual https://www.kingdomhearts.com/kh15manual/kingdom_hearts_15_manual.pdf. They explicitly place the three named characters in Kingdom Hearts game/story material. Only current campaign members named in those manuals are included.
